donor: Advantech AIM8I exact approved Windows/Intel variant

retain.reason: The rugged 8-inch display/enclosure is mechanically expensive to recreate.
Retain only after health/safety checks; no cell repacking.
Sufficient for field console, browser, SSH and serial/network workflows.
Documented interfaces create a clean splice boundary.

add.reason: Physical keyboard, pointing device, mechanical protection and USB/Ethernet breakout.
Adds isolated RS-485, CAN and protected low-voltage digital I/O.
Preconfigured device/service workflows and evidence capture.

reject_if: device identity is not AIM8I Intel/Windows variant
display or touch has unacceptable defects
battery is swollen, unstable or below frozen health threshold
USB 3.0 dock connector cannot be electrically verified
extension connector identity/pinout cannot be verified
required OS cannot boot and expose touch/wireless/USB reliably
unit requires battery-cell repacking or mains-side repair
